metadata.boundary: Exact at Grok Build 1.0.0's documented headless JSON CLI boundary. Installed npm/executable identity is proven only when its optional SHA pin is supplied; npm/source revisions disagree, scheduler internals are outside the boundary, and some compaction, side-model, or unfinished-child usage remains incomplete.
metadata.workspace_owner: Grok Build owns a caller-supplied disposable single-trial worktree; do not add a local environment block.
